Background
After the Coup of 1809, the Swedish Riksdag would eventually appoint Jean Baptise Bernadotte as heir to the Swedish throne in 1810. Bernadotte (who later changed his name to Karl Johan) was one of Napoleon's marshals which thus meant that Sweden was now in the French sphere of influence. Napoleon had demanded that Sweden join the Continental System and declare war on the United Kingdom, starting the Anglo-Swedish war of 1810–1812. However, Karl Johan was a reluctant ally of the French.
